locations._comment_priority_location: Optional. If set, priority_location_terms roles get a fit_score boost, and manager-level (not director+) roles outside them get a penalty, on top of Claude's raw score. Leave all three unset/empty for no location-based scoring adjustment at all.

_comment_industry_preferences: Optional. Claude weighs the posting's company against these when scoring (a company in an avoided industry scores much lower, a company in a favored one scores higher). This is a judgment call Claude makes from the job description, not a keyword filter, since 'industry' isn't structured data. Leave both lists empty for no industry-based scoring influence at all.
